title: Mr. Odong Keeps Us Safe
subtitle: Working Fathers of Soroti
author: Anthony Mwesigwa
description: Follow Mr. Odong as he serves as a police officer, keeping Soroti town safe and peaceful.
keywords: police, officer, safety, Uganda, Soroti, family, work, father, law
dedication: For all those who serve to keep our communities safe.
authorBio: Anthony Mwesigwa is a passionate storyteller from Kampala, Uganda, dedicated to creating engaging educational books for young African readers.
backCoverText: Who keeps us safe? Join Mr. Odong as he patrols the streets, helps people in trouble, and protects his community. A story about courage and service.
